terminology.runtimeSourceOfTruth: Database through GET /api/v1/menu/catalog (and Admin Menu APIs)

reconciliationNarrative.identity_families: DB product families = bootstrap sellable families + discontinued families + topping families. On local postgres: 58 + 6 + 3 = 67.
reconciliationNarrative.identity_skus: DB sellable SKUs = browse SKUs + topping SKUs + inactive/discontinued SKUs. On local postgres: 80 + 7 + 6 = 93.
reconciliationNarrative.why_58_browse_families: Freeze bootstrap contains exactly 58 lifecycle=sellable product codes. Offline fallback expands only those.
reconciliationNarrative.why_129_scratch_families: Scratch menu_canon includes the real-menu EXPAND migration products (especially drinks/sides/wraps) beyond the freeze board, each with its own product_group_slug, plus multi-size pizza families.
reconciliationNarrative.why_157_scratch_skus: 157 = all menu_items after expand + converting every independently priced variant into its own SKU (including 7 topping SKUs).
reconciliationNarrative.why_149_browse_available: 149 = available non-topping SKUs on scratch (157 total − topping SKUs − unavailable).
reconciliationNarrative.why_live_local_67_93: Local supabase postgres holds the reviewed board 1:1 — every one of its 93 SKUs maps to exactly one bootstrap record, so 67 families and 93 SKUs are fully accounted for.
